text_block_list.text:
I'm picking up something on my radar!
The target
is in my sights! Interception in
three, two, one...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Did you see me, Тренер? Did you watch
me
run? ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! ☆ Right?! You see? I'm the one
to
watch! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Miss Top Gun! Маяно Топ Ган!
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text: I'm Otonashi from the Twinkle Monthly. Can I ask how you're feeling about the race?
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You want to interview me?! No
problem! ☆
Ask me anything!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Thank you. Now then...
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
After many trials and tribulations, you
chose to
run the Kikuka Sho. Your
running style exhibits
your aptitude for
long distances...
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Oh, pardon me. Erm, how should I put
this?
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Among your endeavors this year, it
seems like the
Kikuka Sho was your main
focu—
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Um, you don't have to rephrase it. I
understand
what you're saying.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: It's just that I'm not sure why either.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I wanted to race in the Kikuka Sho, so I
raced in
it. Plus, Brian ran it before.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Brian? Are you referring to Нарита Брайан?
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Yep! Watching me race was way more
exciting
than watching Brian, right?
Right?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh... wow.
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
So you raced to compete against Brian!
Amazing!
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Then let me be straightforward and
ask—are you
also going to race in this
year's Arima Kinen?
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen? Me?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Yes. Triple Crown champion Нарита Брайан
has
announced that she's racing in the
Arima this
year.
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't want to pass up the
opportunity to
face off against her
directly, would you?
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen—the final race of the
year. An
arena in which both a racer's
popularity with fans
and their individual
abilities shine through.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Aside from Triple Crown champion
Нарита Брайан,
other noted racers—such as
"Queen of the
Amazons" Hishi
Amazon—have indicated that
they also
intend to take part.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Well then... I guess I'll be there too!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I wonder who will shine the
brightest—the
superstar, or the rising
star? I'm looking forward
to this year's
Arima!
text_block_list.name: Отонаси Эцуко

text_block_list.text:
Heehee. ♪ Guess the Arima Kinen is
next! Let's
do our best, Trainer. ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Are you really sure about the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll be able to directly race against
Brian
there, right?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heehee, I've been waiting for this
opportunity for
so long! This is my
chance to show you...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
That I can make your heart pound way
faster than
Brian can! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Having heard her say it aloud, the goal
she set at
the beginning of the year feels
one step closer
now!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
